Population: Svalbard had 2,595 residents Sept 2024 (Statistics Norway / Wikipedia 'Svalbard and Jan Mayen'); Jan Mayen has no permanent population. Rounded to 2600.

Derivation anchor: Norwegian mainland levels (Svalbard wages/prices are set at Norwegian level). GDP-pc ratio: SJ GDP ~USD277M (UN estimate, Wikipedia) over 2,600 pop ~ USD107k nominal pc vs Norway ~USD87k nominal / ~USD114k PPP -> ratio taken as 1.0; no PPP deflator exists for SJ.

Income/posttax distribution anchored on OECD/WID-style Norway adult post-tax national income (median equivalised disposable income NOK ~548k/yr ~ USD4,700/mo PPP; WID API/bulk CSV unreachable so thresholds approximated from published OECD/SSB figures): p10 1800 / p25 2600 / p50 3600 / p75 4900 / p90 6800 monthly USD PPP.

pretax_national = posttax x1.08 (matches pretax/posttax spread pattern used across this dataset); consumption = posttax x0.72; labor_income scaled slightly below posttax bottom-heavy; wealth net worth per adult anchored on UBS/CS Global Wealth Report Norway (median ~USD120k, mean ~USD390k). All monotonic.
Health metrics anchored to Norway (NCD-RisC 2019 heights: women 167cm, men 180cm; SSB life expectancy 2023: F84.6, M82.0; WHO/NCD-RisC obesity & smoking).

minimumWageEur 2800 derived: Norway/Svalbard have NO statutory minimum wage; de-facto floor from Norwegian collectively agreed minima (cleaning/services ~NOK 197-220/hr ~ NOK 34-38k/month ~ EUR2,800).
costOfLivingIndex 85 estimated: Numbeo has no Svalbard entry; Longyearbyen prices exceed Oslo (Norway country index ~70-75) plus Arctic logistics premium.
unemploymentRate 1 estimated: no official series exists; Longyearbyen labour market is near-full employment.
internetPenetration 98: near-universal fiber via Svalbard Undersea Cable System.
hdi 0.97: SJ is not ranked in HDR; anchored to Norway 0.966 (HDR 2023/24).
exchangeRate 10.6 = 2024 avg USDNOK (current spot 9.3).
mainIndustry changed: Svalbard coal mining is winding down; tourism and research/education are now the largest sectors (Governor of Svalbard / Wikipedia).
englishSpeakingPercent 90 rough estimate: near-universal English in the international Longyearbyen community; official language is Norwegian.
